start.text: The Spire's shaft comes up through the middle of the landing inside a round of pale stone, an iron rail along its top. You lean on the rail.
Down, it goes into the dark further than the ember can follow: past six landings and the twelve steps under the warden's seat, to a cold grate in the lower rooms, where the Hushed were brought.
Up, it goes into the dark as well. The warmth that came up it for nine hundred years has left the stone smooth as a hand, and the stone is cold.
The rail is worn bright in one place, at the height of a leaning elbow. You fit yours to it without trying.
Somewhere below, at the second turn, the cold stands still where she used to lean.
Somewhere below, at the second turn, she's listening. You're sure she is.
